problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by 

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 & -2 & -5 \\ 0 & 2 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -5\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.
worked_solution:
The system corresponding to $M$ is

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x+y-2z=-5 \\ 0x+2y-2z=-3 \\ 0x+0y+0z=-5\end{aligned}
$$

Since there are no such numbers $x,y,z$ that form a solution of the final equation $0x+0y+0z=-5,$ we can conclude that our system has no solution.
